column6: y1[i]: no address register is free for the loop over i (r1..r5 hold c1 (r1), c2 (r2), c3 (r3), c4 (r4), c5 (r5)). End a cursor before the loop, or index with a word counted when running: s.y1[Frac.index (Frac.ofRaw i)] (r0 and n0, no register held)
the loop index i can index state arrays (s.field[i + c]) or be read as Frac.ofRaw i; not <expression>
ring at Y+$9: a 6-word ring starts on a multiple of 8 in the workset (move the field)
probe-stereo: WritePair needs a stereo target, Machinedrum MDS has 1 channel(s)
probe-subroutines-deep: the call to refresh takes 15 system stack levels (a call one, a DO loop two), a machine may take 12
probe-unroll-deep: the call to level1 takes 14 system stack levels (a call one, a DO loop two), a machine may take 12
probe-unsized: state field history is an array: give its length, [<Length n>]
probe-wide: RENDER writes 64 words, the block is 32 frames (one word each)
probe-x-beyond: the [<XMemory>] state needs X+64, the target has 64 words
probe-x-over: the [<XMemory>] state (64 words), locals and spills need more than 64 X words and the Y words after the state (Y+64 to Y+63)
